context: This criteria evaluates the ability to configure and track HTTP redirect behavior, including setting maximum redirect limits and accessing redirect history.

checklist.name: Redirect configuration
checklist.description: Correctly configures the maximum number of redirects to follow using the redirects method

checklist.name: Redirect tracking
checklist.description: Accesses and returns the list of redirect URLs from the response object

checklist.name: Disable redirects
checklist.description: Demonstrates ability to disable automatic redirect following by setting redirects to 0
